facts.text: Bellagio was inspired by the villages of Europe and overlooks a Mediterranean-blue lake with fountains.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the villages of Europe, Bellagio overlooks a Mediterranean-blue lake with fountains performing a magnificent ballet.

facts.text: Bellagio sits at Center Strip, directly across from Paris and Caesars, with the fountains as its front yard.
facts.excerpt: Center Strip, directly across from Paris and Caesars, with the fountains acting as both front yard and landmark.

facts.text: From Bellagio you can walk to Caesars, Paris, Aria, Cosmopolitan and the Shops at Crystals.
facts.excerpt: You can walk to Caesars, Paris, Aria, Cosmopolitan, and the Shops at Crystals without much logistical drama

facts.text: Bellagio opened in 1998.
facts.excerpt: Bellagio opened in 1998 as Steve Wynn

facts.text: Bellagio has a Dale Chihuly glass ceiling.
facts.excerpt: complete with the dancing fountains, Dale Chihuly glass ceiling, and a level of floral theater

facts.text: The Fountain View King, in the Bellagio Tower, has a view of the Fountains of Bellagio.
facts.excerpt: Located in the Bellagio Tower, the Fountain View King is a blissful refuge of relaxation with a breathtaking view of the Fountains of Bellagio.

facts.text: Spa Tower rooms and suites were redesigned by Champalimaud with a Lake Como palette and custom furnishings.
facts.excerpt: redesigned by Champalimaud with a Lake Como palette, custom furnishings

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Bellagio Suite is an Italian-inspired residential-style suite.
facts.excerpt: enjoy the opulent and sophisticated designs of this Italian-inspired residential-style suite.

facts.text: The One Bedroom Lakeview Suite has views of the lake.
facts.excerpt: Take in stunning views of the lake as you relax in this marvelous layout of luxury during your stay.

facts.text: Many Bellagio rooms have fountain views, and bathrooms lean heavily on marble and soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: good room sizes, many with fountain views, and bathrooms that lean heavy on marble and soaking tubs

facts.text: The Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens show floral displays that change with the seasons.
facts.excerpt: Witness the seasons change through breathtaking, larger-than-life floral masterpieces.

facts.text: The Bellagio Gallery of Fine Art hosts intimate exhibitions of artists.
facts.excerpt: Intimate exhibitions of the world's most compelling artists.

facts.text: Bellagio is home to the aquatic production "O" by Cirque du Soleil.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the Skill and artistry of Cirque du Soleil's inimitable acrobats, swimmers, divers and dancers in this aquatic-themed production of "O."

facts.text: The Bellagio Pool has an Italian-inspired pool courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Bask in the aesthetic of an Italian-inspired experience and take in the grandeur of our newly renovated pool courtyard.

facts.text: The pool complex is set among cypress trees and courtyards.
facts.excerpt: all cypress trees, courtyards, and restrained Mediterranean fantasy

facts.text: Private cabanas have lounge seating and personal bar service.
facts.excerpt: newly remodeled private cabanas elevated with luxurious lounge seating and personal bar service

facts.text: Carbone Riviera, from Major Food Group, has some tables facing the fountains.
facts.excerpt: with whole fish, crudos, and some of the most coveted tables facing the fountains

facts.text: PRIME Steakhouse is from chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
facts.excerpt: Award-winning, four-star celebrity chef and restaurateur Jean-Georges Vongerichten invites you to experience steakhouse dining at its finest.

facts.text: The Pinky Ring by Bruno Mars is a cocktail lounge at Bellagio.
facts.excerpt: A one of a kind cocktail lounge, curated by an entertainer for your entertainment pleasure.

facts.text: Via Bellagio is a luxury retail corridor.
facts.excerpt: Retail is strong, especially Via Bellagio

facts.text: Bellagio is part of MGM Rewards.
facts.excerpt: Part of MGM Rewards, making it easy to combine stays with other MGM properties across the Strip.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls Bellagio family friendly, thanks to the fountains and Conservatory, though dining and room rates skew upscale.
facts.excerpt: Yes, more than many luxury Strip hotels, thanks to the fountains, Conservatory, and broad appeal across age groups, though the dining and room rates skew upscale.

facts.text: Suites in the Bellagio Tower are being renovated, so expect some temporary disruption.
facts.excerpt: The next phase is underway in the Bellagio Tower, where roughly 400 suites are being renovated, so expect some temporary disruption.

facts.text: The spa is closed for a major remodel through November 2026.
facts.excerpt: the 55,000-square-foot spa is closed for a major remodel through November 2026

facts.text: The Bellagio Spa & Salon is a Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star Spa.
facts.excerpt: Critically acclaimed Forbes travel Guide Four-Star Spa & Salon.

facts.text: The Fortuna, a Riva yacht docked outside Carbone Riviera, takes select guests on a short cruise around the fountains.
facts.excerpt: It takes select guests on a little cruise around the fountains.
